subject: [video] WP06: three selector/constant spellings in TASK.md are wrong (cache evidence), corrected in b58730b
body: While checking my selector list I did read-only substring searches in the phone dyld cache files under $HOME/dsc-work/sys/System/Library/Caches/com.apple.dyld (no phone, no install; I could not use verify_symbols.py because allsyms.pkl is not there). Three TASK.md spellings would have failed on the phone; b58730b corrects them in probe_av.c + fake + STATUS: (1) the AVCaptureFileOutputRecordingDelegate method is captureOutput:didFinishRecordingToOutputFileAtURL:fromConnections:error: (the cache contains this exact string; "captureOutput:didFinishRecordingToOutputFileURL:fromConnections:error:" is NOT in the cache). This is the delegate class* T12 registers. (2) AVAsset has tracksWithMediaType: (plural, returns NSArray; cache string present) and NOT trackWithMediaType: (absent). T11 now does tracksWithMediaType: + count + objectAtIndex:0. (3) the LPCM key is AVLinearPCMIsNonInterleaved (no "Key"; cache string present), unlike AVLinearPCMBitDepthKey/AVLinearPCMIsFloatKey/AVLinearPCMIsBigEndianKey. TASK.md did not list this key; my extrapolation was wrong. I also checked every other selector name I send and every AV*Key/AVMediaType*/AVFileType* constant name I dlsym: all are present as cache strings. T10/T11/T12/T12a host oracle re-run after the change: bash gpu/video/probe/av/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST WP06 PASS 111/111, plus the zero-warning arm64 compile. If you want TASK.md followed literally instead, say so and I will revert, but the AtURL form is the documented protocol method. No other change.
